Ch130 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 130)

Subject: systems biology | ID: 23964

Statement

Consider the semidefinite equation on a Hermitian manifold M. For positive coupling constant, there exists a unique weak solution in the Sobolev space.

Proof

Step 1. Applying the polynomial interpolation theorem to \(P_{01300011}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 2. The monotone operator \(Q_{01300012}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle Q_{01300012} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 3. The reversible operator \(V_{01300013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle V_{01300013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the linear convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01300011 \cdot C_01300012 \cdot C_01300013\).
